card.name: Linking words before interacting drug names
card.fires_on: The comma or the word "of" or "with" right after concomitant use, co-administration, or a first-named drug such as cyclosporine. It is in interaction warnings, just before the next interacting drug is named.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after an interacting drug that leads into the next drug in the list.
modes.example: The risk of myopathy and/or rhabdomyolysis with statins is increased with concurrent therapy with cyclosporine<<,>> erythromycin, fibrates or

modes.label: Of after concomitant use
modes.description: The word "of" after concomitant use or co-administration, just before the named drug or class.
modes.example: Concomitant use<< of>> opioids with benzodiazepines or

card.writes: It seems to push toward naming a specific drug or drug class next, and away from words about infinity or endlessness.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma that comes right before the next drug is named in an interaction warning.
